answer: Latent-history drawdown: each identity accrues a public aging balance from verified work, paid out on a fixed terrace of milestones. A clone starts at the nadir with zero balance, so its first payout is deferred until it independently completes the same work, while shared referral credit is clawed back one level. The orchard of rewards thus only matures for genuinely separate operators. An attacker cloning N identities pays N times the full work cost and N times the delay, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
